A0_S2_D2: ^Narrator: You try to push the memories of your family's anger aside.
^Narrator: The realm of sleep is calming; quiet. Like the ocean at night.
^Mother: Noelle, one day, you’ll take over as the head of our family.
^Mother: You’ll be the greatest wayfinder amongst us and lead us through the floods.
^Narrator: The ceremony you’d been looking forward to as a child — the special day your mother told you about,
^Narrator: braiding your hair while reminding you of how wonderful it’d be...
^Narrator: She was always strict when it came to the Tempest legacy.
^Narrator: But you never expected the ceremony to take such a turn.
^Mother: The Tempests have guided and led our island to safety for centuries.
^Mother: Once you come of age, you too…
